subject: a zipper opening a solid sculptural cloud
pose: curling inward around an off-center opening
art_direction: 厚实柠黄拉链拉开一朵靛蓝云，内侧露出薄荷折面，拉片像灵巧的小舵。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Make a dense indigo cloud into a sculptural object that can be unzipped. A chunky lemon-yellow zipper follows its lower curve, opening the cloud to reveal a folded mint interior rather than sky. Let the oversized pull tab hang at a jaunty angle, suggesting a small steering fin. The cloud has five unequal lobes and one sharp inward fold, so its silhouette feels designed rather than generic. Use matte rubber-like surfaces with crisp zipper teeth and only a few shadows. Place the object centrally on pale cream, filling roughly seventy percent of the square. Keep the opening readable at thumbnail size and leave all edges safe for a circular crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
